settings.headline: Getting here
settings.body:
Kellisford Family Medicine, 41 Tanner Row, Kellisford (fictional). Phone (555) 018-2200. Free parking behind the building; a ramp enters the front waiting room.

For an emergency, call 911. For urgent questions after hours, call the main line and follow the prompts.
settings.label: Call 911 for chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of a stroke or severe bleeding. Do not wait for a call back.
